ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: A carbonyl center can be seen in the figure, with the oxygen atom O located above and connected to the central carbon by a double bond; the left side of the central carbon is connected to a sulfur atom S bearing H; the lower right side of the central carbon is connected to another sulfur atom S, and this sulfur atom is further connected to the methyl end on the right. There are also curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring these arrows. Reasoning: According to the connectivity, start writing the SMILES from the methyl on the right, as C-S-C; the central carbon has a carbonyl oxygen branch, written as C(=O); the central carbon is also connected to the terminal sulfur on the left, so continue writing S. Combining gives CSC(=O)S.

method.method_draft: First describe the image connectivity: ignoring the curved arrows, the structure has a methyl group attached to S, that S attached to a carbonyl carbon, the carbonyl carbon double-bonded to O, and the same carbonyl carbon single-bonded to a terminal thiol sulfur. Then choose a SMILES traversal starting from the methyl carbon: C-S-C, add the carbonyl oxygen branch as C(=O), and continue to the terminal sulfur, giving CSC(=O)S.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中可见一个羰基中心，氧原子 O 位于上方并以双键连接到中心碳；中心碳左侧连接一个带 H 的硫原子 S；中心碳右下侧连接另一个硫原子 S，该硫原子再连接到右侧的甲基端。图中还有弯曲箭头，但题目要求忽略这些箭头。推理：按连接关系从右侧甲基开始写 SMILES，为 C-S-C；中心碳带有羰基氧分支，写作 C(=O)；中心碳还连接左侧终端硫，因此继续写 S。合并得到 CSC(=O)S。
